# Documenso

Documenso is an open-source electronic signature platform that allows users to create, send, and sign documents digitally.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/documenso/.

## Actions

- **Create Embedding Presign Token V2 Beta**: Create a presign token for embedded authoring sessions.
- **Delete Document Fields**: Delete one or more fields from a document.
- **Delete Template**: Delete a template by ID.
- **Distribute Document V2**: Distribute a document for signing.
- **Download Signed Document**: Download a signed document file.
- **Duplicate Document V2**: Duplicate a document.
- **Find Documents V2**: Find documents.
- **Get Template**: Fetch a template by ID.
- **List Templates**: List templates.
- **Move Document V2**: Move a document to a team.
- **Redistribute Document V2**: Redistribute a document to its pending recipients.
- **Remove Team Member V1**: Remove a member from a team.
- **Resend Document For Signing V1**: Re-send a document for signing via POST /api/v1/documents/{id}/resend.
- **Update Document Fields**: Update one or more fields on a document.
- **Update Document Recipient**: Update a document recipient.
- **Update Document V2**: Update document properties.
- **Use Template (v2-beta)**: Create a document from a template.
